corpus: publisher -> collector -> aggregator shared contract corpus (#1176)
notes: The section captures were read from a real collector-published fleet-feed.json on 2026-11-03, then scrubbed before check-in; no raw feed is stored.
- orchestration.json mirrors the orchestration-pass run orch-2026-10-27T03:14:56Z, captured in PR #1244 (#1110: provenance as an OBJECT { sources, runId }); text and refs have been scrubbed.
- quota.json is a scrubbed QuotaView captured from the real fleet feed; provider/pool names and usage measurements are replaced with deterministic examples.
- dns.json is a scrubbed DnsSection captured from the real fleet feed; domains and editorial values are replaced, while the real status variants and null semantics remain.
- registry.json holds scrubbed SessionRecords captured from the real fleet feed; ids, labels, timestamps, model names, and task refs are synthetic.

- projects.json holds scrubbed ProjectPoolItems captured from the real fleet feed; ids, URLs, refs, titles, labels, author, and timestamps are synthetic. The epic/child relation is retained with example refs.
- feed.json assembles these versioned captures in the shape scripts/collect-fleet-feed.ts writes.
The publisher/ subtree contains small synthetic, hermetic producer-input cases for replaying collector adapters; it is not represented as raw publisher capture data.
Scrubbing: RFC 2606 example domains, synthetic session ids, no tokens/credentials/secret material, no personal data.
Timestamps are frozen so diagnosis assertions stay deterministic; freshness-sensitive tests pin their own `now`.
Contract changes require corpus + both sides in one PR (#1176). Run the pre-publish check: bun run contract:check.
